 How and Where to Watch: Le Havre vs. PSG - live on beIN SPORTS
 PSG close in on history as Luis Enrique stands one step from a record never seen in Paris
 Don't miss all the LIVE excitement of the Le Havre vs PSG match on beIN SPORTS. 
 Top vs. bottom in Ligue 1 as Luis Enrique looks to make history with PSG 
 After a slow start to the season by PSG's standards, the French champions are now back in a familiar place at the top of the Ligue 1 standings. PSG is looking to cement that spot with a win at Le Havre on Friday, live on beIN SPORTS.
 Monday's victory over Lyon was the eighth win in a row for PSG in all competitions, a run that sees the world's best side at the top of the table in both Ligue 1 and also the Champions League. The run that began off the back of a home defeat to Monaco at the beginning of September is even more impressive as the list of teams that have been overcome in this hot spell include Barcelona, Manchester City and Marseille.
 PSG is travelling to the north coast of France on Friday to face a struggling Le Havre team that is bottom of the standings, with just two points and looking to avoid a fifth league defeat in a row.
Injuries to Ousmane Dembélé , Marquinhos, Nuno Mendes and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia combined with a trip to Spain to take on Villarreal in the Champions League on Tuesday means that Luis Enrique is likely to reach deep into the talented PSG squad for the game.
Should PSG prevail on Friday than Luis Enrique would have led the team to 127 wins in his spell in charge, the most for any PSG coach in history, even more incentive for the players to make it nine wins from nine.
